answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the knoll of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
